decision: Adopt the frozen candidate for Revised nonlands. Every reserved title/credit and all five numeric stats improve paired edge F1 at both tiers; median census also improves in each region/tier. Direct crops show improved left title/credit placement and lower/right stats, with thinner paired printed edges. No reserved-image refitting.
limitations: This is within-set component validation, not cross-set transfer. Some cards were seen in earlier body studies.
Goudy and MPlantin stroke widths and shapes still differ. Frame color and texture differences remain.
Mana and type lines are unchanged. Drain Life scan prints {1}{B}, while the input has {X}{1}{B}; source correction is separate.
The numerical study uses fixed family alignment and identical frozen inputs. Higher dark-only or paired edge overlap does not certify ink fill style.
